name: Cizin
subtitle: Lord of Death
description: Bring the plague and fires of Xibalba as you cut through waves of enemies.
lore: The dominant of Omeyocan’s many underworld powers, god of earthquakes and the dead, Cizin resents the fact that, for most souls, his torments are only temporary until they pass on to their proper afterlives. His ambition and sadism drive him to revel in mass death. He encourages the War of Pyramids, and has steadfastly refused to cooperate with Osiris’s Shadow Council.
divinity_generator: Gain [50] Divinity when attacking an enemy under [Acid] or [Blaze].
